title: Choose Owl Compass's visual world
question: The roll assigned Tabling Wall. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tabling Wall
options.lineage: Temple's tabling-season flyer walls and dorm corkboards
options.thesis: Every course is a flyer worth taking a tab from.
options.viewport: Yellow header band with the goal box and major; below it the board, one row per GenEd area in its own paper color, courses as flyers with tear-off tabs; a tray of your taken tabs on the right.
options.risk: Tips into scrapbook clutter if anything beyond the paper colors and the tab comes along.

raised.raise: Live remapping: changing one skill's weight re-ranks every course on the board continuously, no submit button.
Rule apparatus: every plan check carries its Bulletin citation as a hairline margin note.
Fixed furniture: every course flyer carries the same five facts in the same places.
Area colors own whole regions (each area's band and its tabs), never scattered chips.
Match strength on a fixed three-step dot ramp, never a fake-precise percentage.

options.label: Broad Street Line
options.lineage: SEPTA subway maps and station wayfinding
options.thesis: Each skill is a line; the courses that build it are its stops.
options.viewport: Navy signage header with the goal input; results as line-coded rows, each course wearing colored bullets for the skills it builds; your plan drawn as a strip map of stops by GenEd area.
options.risk: Transit-map UI is a familiar trope and where most runs for this product would land; the strip map must earn its place or it becomes a costume.

options.label: Friendly Campus App
options.lineage: warm consumer app surfaces (soft cards, one action color)
options.thesis: A soft, card-by-card app where the only bright color is something you can press.
options.viewport: Goal card on top, one card per suggested course in a single column, and a bottom bar with Compass, Plan, Explore and How it works.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and reads instantly as a working app; loses on audience identification because it could be any campus app.
options.risk: Generic: it looks like every student app unless the copy carries it.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: One slider remaps the whole grid live.
options.viewport: A giant specimen letter over a breathing glyph grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: students don't see themselves in a type specimen.
options.kept: Live remapping: one control re-ranks the whole board continuously.
options.risk: A type-nerd world with nothing of Temple in it.

options.label: Reference Edition
options.thesis: Dense columns with their apparatus hung in the margin.
options.viewport: Two short columns around a centre rail of keys.
options.case: Fuses poorly: reads as a scholarly edition, not a planner.
options.kept: Every rule carries its citation as a hairline margin note.
options.risk: Academic and cold for a first-year.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: A ranked roster where every item has the same fixed furniture.
options.viewport: A pastel grid of ranked mascots with name plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: courses aren't mascots, and clarity drops.
options.kept: Fixed furniture: every card carries the same facts in the same places.
options.risk: Cute at the expense of trust.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.viewport: One dominant lobe per screen with capsule controls.
options.case: Fuses poorly: areas as map lobes would dictate the layout, which a working app can't give up.
options.kept: Area colors own whole regions, never scattered chips.
options.risk: Playful map motion fights a task screen.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Importance drawn as dot size on a fixed magnitude ramp.
options.viewport: Navy plates of ranked dots with faint figure lines.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a night-sky chart isn't a student's world.
options.kept: Match strength on a fixed dot-size ramp, not fake-precise percentages.
options.risk: Moody and remote from registration week.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: Search and filters on the left, a result list with requirement badges, and a plan sidebar on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every course-search tool by design.
